name: Cup with Dragon-and-Cloud Decor
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；Jiajing period, 1522-1566；Enameled blue-and-white ware: porcelain with decoration painted in red enamel on an overglaze yellow enamel ground, the interior with two pairs of underglaze cobalt-blue bowstring lines; with underglaze cobalt-blue mark reading "Da Ming Jiajing nian zhi" on the base
